US Private Sector Hiring Slows in August

Private sector employment in the United States increased by 38,000 jobs in August, a figure lower than anticipated. This slowdown in hiring was reported by ADP, a payroll processing firm. The Wall Street Journal noted that private-sector hiring slowed in August, while CNBC reported that private payrolls rose by 38,000, which was less than expected.
